values.quote: {{pplevel|4; then +0.2*x for 5;then +0.65*x|formula=3.8 + 0.2 per level until level 6, then +0.65 per level|key=%}} '''maximum''' health

values.quote: after a {{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Reduced by attack speed.}}-second delay
values.binNote: The wiki's 0.25s attack windup delay is not represented as its own data value in the sheet; it likely comes from base attack windup mechanics rather than a MaokaiPassive field.

cooldown reduction instead applied when struck by a large monster's basic attack or ability

values.meaning: passive will not trigger while Maokai is above this fraction of maximum health
values.quote: will not trigger if he is above {{sti|{{as|95% '''maximum''' health}}}}

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack resets Maokai's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Sap Magic {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Maokai's''' basic attack timer

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack has an uncancellable windup.
mechanics.quote: empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}

mechanics.claim: Sap Magic does not proc if Maokai starts his attack windup before its cooldown has elapsed.
mechanics.quote: ''Sap Magic'' does not occur if '''Maokai''' begins his {{tip|attack windup}} before its cooldown has elapsed.

mechanics.claim: Sap Magic does not occur if the empowered attack is dodged or missed while blinded, but does occur if it is blocked.
mechanics.quote: ''Sap Magic'' does not occur if the attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}} and/or missed if '''Maokai''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}. It will occur if it is {{tip|block|blocked}}.

mechanics.claim: Sap Magic's cooldown is reduced by casting an ability, hitting an enemy champion or epic monster with Sapling Toss, or being struck by an enemy ability.
mechanics.quote: Each time '''Maokai''' casts an {{tip|ability}}, hits at least one enemy champion or epic monster with ''{{ai|Sapling Toss|Maokai}}'', or is struck by an enemy's ability, ''Sap Magic's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 4 seconds

mechanics.claim: If Maokai has a spell shield that consumes an enemy ability, he still receives the cooldown reduction.
mechanics.quote: If '''Maokai''' possesses a {{tip|spell shield}} and it consumes an enemy ability, he will still receive the cooldown reduction.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack will not trigger against structures or wards.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.
